description: The downstream repository of the mechanical cascade as the gate tests of SPEC-03 AC56, AC57 and AC62 see it. A nested git repository cannot be committed to this one, so tests/s3/mechanical-gate.test.mjs materialises this recipe into real repositories (git plumbing, no network). {{PREVIOUS_SHA}} and {{UPSTREAM_SHA}} are replaced by the revisions of the dispatch. The importer's failure triggers are the throws of scripts/import-ghec-admin.mjs of the downstream, re-read for this recipe (SPEC-03 OQ1, OQ2, OQ3, AC64): every one of them is thrown before the first write to public/ghec-admin (the writes start at line 222), so a failed import leaves a clean worktree and no commit.

move-into-allowed.description: keep.txt (outside the allowed paths) is moved to public/ghec-admin/keep.txt: git names only the destination of a rename unless renames are switched off
